answer: Require each agent identity to stake a meaningful, time-locked deposit before it can vouch or attest, so creating fake identities carries a real cost. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, reputation should grow slowly from verified work, not from volume. A sybil farm facing a deep canyon of locked stake per identity finds mass forgery unprofitable: each new sockpuppet must pay again, and slashing burns the deposit when cheating is proven. Even a small knoll of honest history then outweighs a flood of cheap, stake-free clones.
